_doc: ROLLER parts (wheeled_robot.glb). World after import: Z up (-0.01..2.04), X = arm span (symmetric), Y = front/back (claws at -Y). The wheel is the cylinder of radius 0.345 about the x axis through (y -0.03, z 0.33), inboard of |x| 0.12 (the tire's outer sidewall lip at |x| 0.12-0.14 stays with the fork: two thin stays run from the hub up the front at that x; the fork legs and hub caps are outside it; the mudguard bracket over its top rear starts at radius 0.35); the coiled arms are everything outboard of the drum's sides (|x| 0.31) between z 0.85 and the shoulder housings' top at 1.49. tools/blender/split_regions.py
